items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'he' (likely a relative) and his godmother, while the interviewer clarifies the godmother's name is Lally. The interviewee does not claim a personal relationship with Lally.

ctx.x: No, the only thing when I can say anything concrete is when he moved to Biloxi, and everybody knew that he was there, and in Alabama, and things like that. But I don't know anything about— That was with his godmother over there. With his godmother and godfather over there. Sometimes he spoke of her name as Bing Echo. Had that been her—
Echo? E-C-H-O. Was this—that might have been her maiden name before she was married. But her name was Lally. You should call her Lally. Yes. Uh-huh. Yes. And he doesn't call her that.
